Register BUILD at 0x004 reads the USR_ACCESSE2 word of the bitstream.

h_rdata shows the addressed register within 2 clk25 cycles of h_re.

Each output equals saturate16((sum of h[k]*x[n-k] + 0x4000) >>> 15) bit for bit against the Python model.
The sum uses no intermediate rounding.
Samples before the first sample are 0.
The impulse response equals the coefficients of data/coeffs.hex after rounding.
The datapath uses 16 multipliers mapped to DSP slices.

clk_dp runs at 250 MHz or faster with worst negative slack of 0 ns or more.
The input FIFO holds 1024 samples.
The output FIFO holds 1024 samples.
IN_PUSH to a full input FIFO is ignored.
RUN processes all input FIFO samples in order into the output FIFO.
Filter history persists across RUN commands until CLEAR.
Ten thousand random samples sent in chunks of 1000 give the same outputs as one single pass.
OUT_POP returns bit 31 = 1 and bits 15:0 = the oldest output.
A read of OUT_POP removes the oldest output from the output FIFO.
OUT_POP returns 0 when the output FIFO is empty.
STATUS bit 0 is 1 while a RUN is in progress.
STATUS bits 15:4 give the input FIFO count from 0 to 1024.
STATUS bits 31:20 give the output FIFO count from 0 to 1024.
SAT_COUNT counts the outputs that saturated since CLEAR.
SAMPLES_DONE counts the samples processed since CLEAR.
CTRL bit 0 CLEAR empties both FIFOs.

CTRL bit 0 CLEAR zeroes SAMPLES_DONE.
CTRL bit 0 reads back 0 after the write.
CTRL bit 1 RUN reads back 0 after the write.
